name: Sea Lake Silo Art

facts.claim: Mural on the grain silos at 33 Railway Ave, Sea Lake, on the Silo Art Trail
Shows a young girl swinging from a Mallee eucalypt, looking over Lake Tyrrell
Lake Tyrrell's Indigenous name 'Tyrille' means 'space opening to the sky'; the Boorong people are noted for their astronomy

name: Patchewollock Silo Art

facts.claim: Fintan Magee's 2016 portrait of farmer Nick 'Noodle' Hulland on 35 m-high 1939 GrainCorp silos
Located on Baring Road, Patchewollock, on the Silo Art Trail
Magee stayed at the local pub while preparing the mural
Wikipedia calls it the town's most notable feature

name: Goroke Silo Art

facts.claim: Endangered birds painted on silos among gums in Goroke, by fauna artist Geoffrey Carran
At 1 Railway Street, Goroke, about an hour from Horsham

name: Serviceton Silo Art
